I write Python and call Anthropic directly, with no agent framework. How should I structure tracing for my own tool-calling loop?

dom_observation.firstAnswerText:
Instrument the loop yourself with Weave's Agents tracing API. Wrap the session in a conversation. Wrap each user exchange in a turn. Inside the turn, wrap every Anthropic messages.create call in an LLM span and every tool you run in a tool span [S1, S2]. These spans are what make your trace show up in the Agents view [S2].

Setup

You need a CoreWeave Forge API key (set as WANDB_API_KEY) and Python 3.10+ [S3, S4]. Install weave along with your Anthropic SDK [S6].
Call weave.init("team/project") first. It authenticates and sets up the exporter that sends agent spans to the Agents view [S4].
Since you're adding the spans by hand to a plain provider SDK, pass implicitly_patch_integrations: False to weave.init. If you leave automatic patching on, each call is logged twice: once as your span and once as a traced Op [S1].

How the pieces nest

start_conversation groups turns. start_turn is one exchange (invoke_agent span), start_llm is one API call (chat span) and start_tool is one tool run (execute_tool span) [S2].
Use them as with blocks. When the block exits, the span ends and its data is flushed, even if an exception was raised [S2].
A tool span automatically becomes a child of whatever span is currently active, usually the open turn [S7].
On each LLM span, record the output and token usage, and optionally the response ID and model [S5].
Tracing doesn't give the model memory. You still have to pass the message history back to Claude yourself (this example does that).
import json
import anthropic
import weave

weave.init("[YOUR-TEAM]/[YOUR-PROJECT]",
           settings={"implicitly_patch_integrations": False})
client = anthropic.Anthropic()
MODEL = "[YOUR-CLAUDE-MODEL]"
TOOLS = [...]  # your Anthropic tool schemas

def run_tool(name, args):
    ...  # your tool implementation

def run_turn(history, user_message):
    history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_message})
    with weave.start_turn(user_message=user_message, model=MODEL):
        while True:
            with weave.start_llm(model=MODEL, provider_name="anthropic") as llm:
                resp = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=1024,
                                              messages=history, tools=TOOLS)
                text = "".join(b.text for b in resp.content if b.type == "text")
                llm.output(text)
                llm.record(
                    usage=weave.Usage(input_tokens=resp.usage.input_tokens,
                                      output_tokens=resp.usage.output_tokens),
                    response_id=resp.id, response_model=resp.model)
            history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": resp.content})
            tool_uses = [b for b in resp.content if b.type == "tool_use"]
            if not tool_uses:
                return text
            results = []
            for b in tool_uses:
                with weave.start_tool(name=b.name, arguments=json.dumps(b.input),
                                      tool_call_id=b.id) as tool:
                    tool.result = run_tool(b.name, b.input)
                results.append({"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": b.id,
                                "content": str(tool.result)})
            history.append({"role": "user", "content": results})

with weave.start_conversation(agent_name="[YOUR-AGENT-NAME]"):
    history = []
    print(run_turn(history, "[USER QUESTION]"))
